status: UNCOMPILED source-only draft; no Lean process launched during solver window
scope: Backward monotone fan-in-two multioutput DAG; each output accepts every singleton in its target and rejects the full complement of that target. Pairwise target intersection has cardinality at most one. Conclusion: OR count at least sum of target cardinalities minus one. Arbitrary AND gates are allowed. This does not apply to cap-only promise outputs and does not prove the posted 51 bound.
dependencies: Cached TwentyOne.olean supplies Routes.mcount and FourRowsSensitivity.val_mono
proof: Each target has exactly |S|-1 merging-OR charges from mcount. Each charged OR accepts two distinct target singletons. A gate rejecting complement(T) cannot accept a singleton outside T by monotonicity. Two charges on the same gate would force two elements in the intersection of distinct targets.
